Vermont's Acts 167 and 68: Hospital Global Budgets and Their Fiscal Implications

A central requirement is a timeline: the GMCB is to establish global hospital budgets for one or more non-critical-access hospitals by hospital fiscal year 2027 and for all Vermont hospitals by hospital fiscal year 2030.

Act 68 of 2025 then set the timeline: beginning no later than hospital fiscal year 2028, the GMCB is to put one or more non-critical-access hospitals on global budgets, and all Vermont hospitals by hospital fiscal year 2030 — both to the extent resources are available.

Act 167 commits Vermont to a hard timeline most states would not dare set: global budgets for at least one non-critical-access hospital by FY2027 and for all 14 hospitals by FY2030 — a deliberate, legislated transition away from fee-for-service for an entire state's hospital system.

Together, Acts 167 and 68 commit Vermont to a timeline most states would not set: global budgets for at least one non-critical-access hospital from FY2028 and for all 14 hospitals by FY2030 — a legislated transition away from fee-for-service for an entire state's hospital system.
